title: REBUILD Decision Outcome
description: Backfilling the actual outcome of a decision. The methodology requires that a review compare expected against actual, distinguish execution failure from strategy failure, and record how the next step changes — only when this is filled in is the decision loop closed.

expected.description: The outcome expected at the time; must correspond to the validation actions in the decision record

actual.description: The outcome actually observed. When there is no data, state "no data was collected"; impressions must not be used as a substitute

deviation_type.description: AS_EXPECTED=as expected (no attribution needed); EXECUTION=execution failure (right direction, insufficient force); STRATEGY=strategy failure (the direction itself was wrong); ASSUMPTION=key assumption was wrong; MIXED=multiple causes; UNKNOWN=cannot be attributed. **Note that AS_EXPECTED is a legitimate and important value** — not every review can find a deviation, and "it happened as expected" is itself a conclusion. This value was previously absent from the enum, so an as-expected outcome could only be forced into UNKNOWN, which amounts to describing "everything is normal" as "cannot be attributed".

evidence_ids.description: IDs in the evidence ledger that support this review's judgement

next_action.description: CONTINUE / ADJUST / STOP / ROLLBACK to the affected decision phase
